<b>Cragglites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are infant forms of the [[Craggler]] that appear once it has been defeated.<ref>Cragglite [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Infant form of the more formidable Craggler."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Simply walks left or right at random for half a second, pausing in between movements for about a second.<br>
Does not react to anything and deals {{Damage|1}} of contact damage.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cragglites have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Our time has come...
* The great one, defeated...
* Fallen shell, fallen feast!
* Now we grow... we grow...
}}

== Location ==
Three Cragglites appear in the [[Wormways]] in the same room as the [[Craggler]] after it has been defeated, the <i>[[SEARCH: Silent Halls]]</i> [[Acts|objective]] has been completed, and Hornet has rested at a bench outside of the Wormways, [[Bone Bottom]], or [[the Marrow]].

==Trivia==
* Cragglites first appeared in the 2019 <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, crawling along the platforms within the cut [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Areas|Pharloom Bay]] area.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>
** Though impossible under normal circumstances, Cragglites can walk on walls. This is likely leftover code as they are seen crawling on ceilings in the reveal trailer.
